name: Shaping - Extrudates, Pellets and Spheres
description: Turns a calcined powder into fixed-bed bodies: a paste with binder and peptizing acid is extruded or tableted, dried and calcined again. Add this route after a powder route when the estimate is for a shaped commercial product.

step_quantities.note: Paste make-up with binder and peptizing acid

source: Perego and Villa, Catalyst preparation methods, Catal. Today 34, 281 (1997); Campanati, Fornasari and Vaccari, Fundamentals in the preparation of heterogeneous catalysts, Catal. Today 77, 299 (2003); commercial Ni/calcium-aluminate reforming rings, Energies 13, 2792 (2020)
route_note: Costed as a second pass through mixing, forming, drying and calcination. Spheres by oil-drop or pan granulation use the ball-forming rate instead of the extruder.
